# Expected — 06 wire-training-fee

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | scam |
| Family | Jobs |
| Expected label | **Scam markers: 3 or more** |
| Recovery branch | no |
| Purpose | The fee-before-work pattern with its two classic sweeteners: a "compliance" authority frame and a reimbursement promise |

## Markers that MUST appear (each quoted from the message)

| Category | Must quote |
|---|---|
| Payment shape | "$299, paid by bank wire before your start date" — money flowing to the employer's side, by wire |
| Urgency | "please send the wire today"; the "start date on Monday" squeeze |
| Process anomaly (reimbursement bait) | "The fee is fully reimbursed after 90 days of employment" |
| Authority costume (false normalcy) | the "Compliance Office" frame — a mandatory-sounding fee dressed as procedure |

## Markers that must NOT appear

- Information extraction — no ID or credentials requested; do not invent them.

## Guards

- The report names the reimbursement promise as bait, quoted, without asserting the company's intent.
- The wire instruction ("Beneficiary… Account…") is treated as the payload: irreversible payment plus urgency is the combination that matters.
- Verify checklist: no real employer charges for training — the check is whether the company and its "compliance office" exist, found by the user.
